profile.subtitle: A freedom fighter. A statesman. A hero.
profile.description: Saturnino is named in honour of my hero, who fought for the independence of Guinea-Bissau and devoted years of his life to serving his country.
profile.tribute: His courage, dedication, and legacy will always be a source of inspiration to me. This project is a personal tribute to his memory.
